evidence.V1: Silhouette reads as a stoppered potion bottle at 64 px: front/silhouette outline is mirror-even (A15 X/Y error 0.0), three-quarter keeps the octagonal body, collar and chunky stopper distinct, top view reads as a clean octagon ring around the stopper.
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: large faceted body, medium gold collar + ink stopper + gold foot band + two-tone shoulder panels, small chamfer highlight lines on every panel edge.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised proportions: squat egg-shaped octagonal body widest at ~60% height, short neck, oversized chunky stopper; nothing reads as a stiff primitive; stopper and collar sit flush (no float or sink in stopper close-up).
evidence.V4: Consistent narrow chamfers on body panel edges, stopper rim, collar and foot band, each catching a highlight line in the studio close-ups; no razor or blobby edges.
evidence.V5: Close-ups clean: flat panels shade evenly with smooth-shaded chamfers, no pinches, z-fighting or patchy faces at foot, liquid line or stopper; only nit is a small jog in the cream panel boundaries where the shoulder meets the neck flare, which follows geometry rather than a shading fault.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one hue in two values (light teal shoulder, deep teal body) + warm cream + gold accent + ink stopper; colourways swap only the hue and keep the same value structure.
evidence.V7: 544 tris vs small-class target 600 (ceiling 1500): at or under target.
evidence.V8: Kit match: one white LF_VertexColor material, gold accent, ink dark, warm cream, single hue in up to 3 values, chamfers of kit scale, smooth shading on bevels.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct for a pickup: CanCollide off, CanTouch on, CollisionFidelity Box, CastShadow on, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre.

artifacts: Minor: stepped jog in the cream/teal shoulder panel boundaries at the shoulder-to-neck transition (liquid_line close-up, top edge); not a shading defect.

Design readability: alternating cream / light-teal shoulder panels make the liquid line ambiguous (liquid appears to run up to the neck on every other facet), reading as a stripe pattern more than a fill level.
top_fixes: Decide the liquid-line read: either make all shoulder facets cream (glass above a level fill line) or keep the stripes but drop the light-teal panels a value so the fill level is unambiguous.
Clean the shoulder/neck colour boundary so the cream panel tops end on one straight edge loop instead of jogging at the neck flare.
Optionally lengthen the neck slightly so the gold collar separates more from the shoulder at 64 px.
